items.prompt: Citra has 9 stickers and Dika has 4 stickers. Build a comparison model with one unit for each sticker.
hints: Each unit stands for one sticker.
Make one bar for each child.
Citra gets 9 units and Dika gets 4 units.
items.explanation: Citra has 9 units and Dika has 4 units. The longer bar shows who has more.

items.explanation: The tall tower is 11 units and the short tower is 7 units. The difference is 4 units.
